def _extract_region_pyr_fracs(donor_id: str, data_root: Path) -> dict:
    """Return dict mapping region -> pyramidal-neuron fraction for one donor."""
    cohort = load_training_cohort(data_root)
    row = cohort.loc[cohort["donor_id"] == donor_id]
    if row.empty:
        return {}
    slide_name = str(row.iloc[0]["slide_name"])
    zarr_path = data_root / slide_name

    centroids = load_centroids(zarr_path)
    class_ids = load_class_ids(zarr_path)
    class_lookup = load_class_lookup(zarr_path)
    region_polygons = load_region_polygons(zarr_path)

    # Assign cells to regions
    region_labels = assign_centroids_to_regions(centroids, region_polygons)

    # Build class name array
    cell_types = np.array([class_lookup.get(int(c), "Unknown") for c in class_ids])

    result = {}
    for reg in REGIONS_OF_INTEREST:
        mask = region_labels == reg
        n_total = int(mask.sum())
        if n_total < MIN_CELLS:
            result[reg] = np.nan
            continue
        n_pyr = int(((cell_types == "Pyramidal Neuron") & mask).sum())
        result[reg] = n_pyr / n_total
    return result
